text: Carbon steel surfaces to be coated shall be blast cleaned to Sa 2.5 (ISO 8501-1) with angular abrasive; surface profile 50 to 85 micrometres (medium, ISO 8503, comparator G or S) for systems with zinc-rich primer, 40 to 70 micrometres for other systems. Weld spatter, sharp edges (radiused to at least 2 mm) and laminations shall be removed prior to blasting (ISO 8501-3 grade P3).
